cards.ex: That dress really made her turn heads at the party.
cards.exUz: O'sha ko'ylak uni ziyofatda haqiqatan ham odamlarning e'tiborini tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni o'ziga jalb qilish, ko'pchilikning e'tiborini qozonish.

cards.ex: I always dress to impress when I have a job interview.
cards.exUz: Ish intervyusiga borganimda doim taassurot qoldirish uchun kiyinaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini chiroyli ko'rsatish uchun maxsus kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: She's aging gracefully; you'd never guess she's over 60.
cards.exUz: U juda go'zal qarimoqda; uning 60 dan oshganini hech qachon taxmin qilmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Keksalik davrida ham chiroyli va sog'lom bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: She doesn't need makeup; she's a natural beauty.
cards.exUz: Unga makiyaj kerak emas; u tabiiy go'zal.
cards.uzDef: Makiyajsiz ham chiroyli bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Ever since she started dating Mark, she's had a real glow.
cards.exUz: Mark bilan uchrashishni boshlaganidan beri u haqiqatan ham nur sochmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va baxtli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: We're going out tonight, so I'm going to get all dolled up.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun ko'chaga chiqamiz, shuning uchun men o'zimni bezatmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim kiyib, makiyaj qilib, chiroyli ko'rinishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She always looks perfect, not a hair out of place.
cards.exUz: U doimo mukammal ko'rinadi, bironta ham sochi joyida emasdek.
cards.term: not a hair out of place
cards.uzDef: Ideal tartibli ko'rinish, sochi mukammal turishi.

cards.ex: He's definitely easy on the eyes.
cards.exUz: U aniq ko'zga yoqimli.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rish uchun chiroyli, yoqimli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: He may seem a bit rough around the edges, but he's a diamond in the rough.
cards.exUz: U biroz qo'pol ko'rinishi mumkin, lekin u xom olmos.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishi oddiy, lekin ichki dunyosi boy.

cards.ex: She always looks effortlessly chic, even in jeans and a t-shirt.
cards.exUz: U doimo osonlik bilan zamonaviy ko'rinadi, hatto jinsi shim va futbolkada ham.
cards.uzDef: Urinmasdan ham chiroyli va zamonaviy ko'rinish.

cards.ex: I've put on a little weight since I stopped going to the gym.
cards.exUz: Sport zaliga borishni to'xtatganimdan beri biroz vazn orttirdim.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznining ko'payishi.

cards.ex: She wants to lose weight before her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yidan oldin ozmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Tana vaznining kamayishi.

cards.ex: Many teenagers struggle with body image issues.
cards.exUz: Ko'p o'smirlar tana tasviri muammolari bilan kurashadilar.
cards.uzDef: O'zining tashqi ko'rinishi haqida fikr.

cards.ex: She got a makeover and looks like a completely different person.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishini o'zgartirdi va butunlay boshqa odamga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishni yaxshilash uchun o'zgartirish (soch, makiyaj, kiyim).

cards.ex: I always cover up in the sun to protect my skin.
cards.exUz: Terimni himoya qilish uchun quyoshda doim yashiraman.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim bilan tananing bir qismini yopish.

cards.ex: It's a casual office, so we can dress down on Fridays.
cards.exUz: Bu oddiy ofis, shuning uchun juma kunlari oddiy kiyinishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan, oddiy kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: We're going to a fancy restaurant, so we need to dress up.
cards.exUz: Biz hashamatli restoranga boramiz, shuning uchun chiroyli kiyinishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy, chiroyli kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: I try to keep in shape by going to the gym three times a week.
cards.exUz: Haftada uch marta sport zaliga borib, formamni saqlashga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatni yaxshi saqlash, sport bilan shug'ullanish.

cards.ex: After he lost his job, he really let himself go.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotgandan so'ng, u o'zini haqiqatan ham tashlab qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z tashqi ko'rinishiga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: Inner beauty is more important than physical appearance.
cards.exUz: Ichki go'zallik tashqi ko'rinishdan ko'ra muhimroq.
cards.uzDef: Insonning xarakteri, fazilatlari orqali ko'rinadigan go'zallik.

cards.ex: Beauty can be a double-edged sword; it can attract attention, but also unwanted attention.
cards.exUz: Go'zallik ikki tig'li qilich bo'lishi mumkin; u e'tiborni jalb qilishi mumkin, lekin istalmagan e'tiborni ham jalb qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ikkala tomoni ham foydali, ham zararli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Looks aren't everything; personality is just as important.
cards.exUz: Tashqi ko'rinish hamma narsa emas; shaxsiyat ham xuddi shunday muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinish asosiy narsa emas.

cards.ex: She plucks her eyebrows every week.
cards.exUz: U har hafta qoshlarini teradi.
cards.uzDef: Qosh shaklini yaxshilash uchun tuklarni terish.

cards.ex: It takes me about 20 minutes to put on makeup.
cards.exUz: Menga makiyaj qilish uchun taxminan 20 daqiqa ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Kosmetik vositalarni yuzga surtish.

cards.ex: You should always take off your makeup before going to bed.
cards.exUz: Yotishdan oldin har doim makiyajingizni o'chirib tashlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yuzdagi kosmetik vositalarni tozalash.

cards.ex: He's so vain; he spends hours looking in the mirror.
cards.exUz: U juda manman; u soatlab ko'zguga qarab vaqt o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z tashqi ko'rinishiga haddan tashqari e'tiborli.

cards.ex: She's a very stylish woman.
cards.exUz: U juda moda ayol.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi moda tendentsiyalariga mos kiyingan.

cards.ex: It's important to wear fashionable clothes
cards.exUz: Modaga mos kiyim kiyish muhim
cards.uzDef: Modaga mos, zamonaviy kiyingan.

cards.ex: I love your outfit!
cards.exUz: Sening kiyimlaring juda yoqadi!
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda kiyilgan kiyimlar to'plami.

cards.ex: I'm going to hit the gym after work.
cards.exUz: Ishdan keyin sport zaliga boraman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar qilish uchun sport zaliga bormoq.
